model_policy.why: The tier comes from a judgment (Jev), not from a hand-written seat table. seed_corrections.seed: H5 - "no per-file manifest for the tree body, and no runtime check"
seed_corrections.verdict: REFUTED as stated (four clusters agree: C1, C2, C3, C4)
seed_corrections.truth: A 1972-entry {path: sha256} manifest exists in the installed payload-manifest.json AND in installation.json -> runtimes[active].files. A runtime check exists too: the shipped setup_cli.py verify re-hashes the tree and FAILS today. The manifest is unread by python/synapse/ and the verify command is never invoked automatically. The real defect is the missing automatic invocation, not the missing manifest.
seed_corrections.measured_drift: Exactly 1 of 1972 files mismatches: houdini/python_panels/synapse_panel.pypanel. Interval 46.147 h, not ~21 h. Drift content: <includeInPaneTabMenu menu_position="0" create_separator="false"/> added; 3 UTF-8 em-dashes replaced by plain spaces (installed non-ASCII count 0, repo count 9) - matching the Houdini .pypanel signature byte-pattern-for-byte-pattern.

seed_corrections.verdict: CONFLICT BETWEEN LEGS - unresolved, carried to SEAM
seed_corrections.truth: C3 re-measured with netstat and found TWO listeners (52896 and 32832) and doctor reporting pid 52896 while the socket belonged to 32832. C1 re-measured with Get-NetTCPConnection and found exactly ONE listener. C3 additionally found a third houdini.exe (65468, started 10/22 15:12, on 127.0.0.1:10099). The disagreement is itself a finding and is NOT resolved here.

seed_corrections.seed: H1 - a behavioural divergence between the two trees would still report green
seed_corrections.truth: The mechanism is confirmed - preflight.version_check compares version STRINGS only (preflight.py:216); no content hash is in the compare. But on this host the two code sets are currently content-identical, so no live divergence exists to observe. A naive byte digest would false-positive: 34 files differ only by line endings (installed LF, working tree CRLF) and 71 payload files are absent from the working tree.

seed_corrections.verdict: CONFIRMED, live, by every cluster that looked
seed_corrections.truth: H2: top-level synapse_version (protocol.py:235-236) and payload['client_version'] (mcp_server.py:511) are two carriers never cross-checked, read at websocket.py:126 / hwebserver_adapter.py:109 and handlers.py:994 respectively. H3: mcp/server.py:244 calls preflight_gate.admit(holder, tool_name) with no client_version, so version_check returns NOT_APPLICABLE and cannot refuse on the in-Houdini HTTP endpoint.

seed_corrections.verdict: CONFIRMED, and measured against this wave itself
seed_corrections.truth: C5 read this wave's own transcripts: meta.json records model=haiku for all five MAP seats while the transcripts record the session model. It also found the capability ALREADY EXISTS in the product tree - anthropic_provider.py:342 sets reported_model from the live SSE message_start, model_access.py:618 finish_attempt(reported_model=...) - and ZERO readers of it anywhere in harness/.

carriers_beyond_the_seed: mcp/server.py:302-310 derives a FOURTH version with a hardcoded fallback "5.8.0", reported at mcp/server.py:621.

The WebSocket handshake publishes only protocol_version (websocket.py:511,531,550,573,698; hwebserver_adapter.py:163,187,196,219,236) and never the server's SYNAPSE version - peer identity is one-way: the client asserts, the server never answers.
cache_policy.models synapse_version (models.py:415, :654) is a declared field with no producer found.
~/.synapse/auth.key does not exist on this host, so server/auth.py:40-84 returns None and the WS greeting path (websocket.py:502-512) is never exercised - the root enabler for a false peer.
known_false_positive_traps: 474 files in the installed tree are NOT manifest-listed (473 __pycache__/*.pyc plus .synapse/agent_health_history.jsonl, written by panel/agent_health.py:185 into $SYNAPSE_ROOT/.synapse/). A naive tree==manifest predicate false-positives on a clean tree.
34 files differ between installed and working tree by line endings alone (installed LF, working tree CRLF). A naive byte digest false-positives on them.
